name: closing-call-to-action-templates
purpose: The close for a page whose last ask is "start from a template": a framed split whose start cell carries the ask — headline, sentence and two actions, start-aligned — over the pixelated, waving texture of the `primary` close, and whose end cell is a scrolling two-column grid of deployable template cards, each with its mark, name, one line and a deploy button, its top and bottom fading out; then the tall hatched closing frame. Below `lg` the cells stack, the ask first. It merges the `primary` close of `closing-call-to-action` with the scrolling template wall of `template-gallery`. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action-templates', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `scroll-area`, `card-grid`, `card-grid-cell`, `frame-box` and `texture-material`.
useWhen: To close a framework, solution or developer page on a ready-to-deploy start rather than on a sign-up alone.
avoidWhen: For a close on one or two link actions → use `closing-call-to-action` (`primary` for the same loud register without the templates).
For a mid-page band that browses many templates beside its copy → use `template-gallery`.
For a close whose reader may be an agent → use `closing-call-to-action-agents`.
related: closing-call-to-action` — the `primary` close, centred, without the template grid.
template-gallery` — a scrolling wall of templates beside its copy, as a mid-page band.
bestPractices: Give the grid six to eight templates so it overflows its height and reads as scrollable; an even count keeps its two columns full.
Keep each template line to one short sentence so the cards keep one height.
Give every card an `href` and set `deployLabel`, or no card shows its deploy button.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered as its `h2` and naming its region; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: The white button under the copy; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: The outlined button beside the primary one; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: templates
props.doc: The template cards of the scrolling grid beside the copy, in order; each is `{ title, description?, icon?, invertInDark?, href? }`. Templates without a title are skipped and the grid is omitted when none is left.

props.name: deployLabel
props.doc: Label of the deploy button on each card; a card renders its button only when both this and its `href` are set.

props.name: templatesAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the scrolling grid of templates.
